$comment: AFLDB-ISSUE-093 Phase 2 — fitzRoy acquisition contract. `pinned_version` is the approved fitzRoy version (§5 of AFLDB-ISSUE-093.md); acquire_core.R fails closed on any other installed version unless --allow-version-mismatch is passed, and every probe/manifest records the version actually used. Field `status` values: SUPPORTED, SUPPORTED_WITH_COVERAGE_LIMITATION, WRONG_GRAIN, MISSING, UNVERIFIED. All statuses start UNVERIFIED and are only promoted on probe/acquisition evidence — never on assumption.

player_stats.probe_note: Probe run 1 (2026-08-25) failed with "object 'dictionary_afltables' not found" when called via fitzRoy:: without attaching the package; probe run 2 (same day, after library(fitzRoy) attach in acquire_core.R) SUCCEEDED: 9,936 rows for season 2024, 78 columns. Statuses below are from probe run 2 evidence. Historical-era coverage is still to be measured at acquisition — a single 2024 probe cannot prove completeness.
